description: Agent Datasets: submit a dataset’s current schema with its documented or prior schema: the documented schema with its version, where it comes from (a data dictionary, a schema file, a prior release, a data contract, a readme or other) and each field with its name, type, whether it may be null, whether it is required and its description; the current schema with its version and the same fields; the renames the release records, each from a documented field to a current one; the readers with each one’s name and the fields it reads; and the change with whether the release was declared none, compatible or breaking, its version bump (none, patch, minor or major) and its release notes, read for wording such as no breaking changes or backward compatible. The signed report gives every field as unchanged, added, removed, renamed, retyped, type_widened, nullable_now or required_now and as breaking or compatible for a reader, the changes with both versions, the declaration, the bump and whether it fits the drift, every reader with the fields a breaking change touches, and counts them, and names a broken schema: a removal, rename, narrowing type change or newly nullable field shipped without a breaking declaration and a major version or under notes that deny it, a reader that reads a broken field and a recorded rename with no field behind it; then breaking changes declared with a major version that readers must still move to, and compatible changes shipped under no declaration or no version bump, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. An unstated declaration, bump, field type or reader list leaves the drift unchecked. This reads one dataset schema against its documented one: two versions of one text compared clause by clause are wever_contract-diff-check, behavior against a written spec is wever_spec-drift-check and two evaluation runs compared are wever_evaluation-drift-check. Verdict dataset_schema_broken, dataset_schema_partial, dataset_schema_unchecked or dataset_schema_stable. POST /api/dataset-schema-drift-check. Reads the dataset records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Datasets reads a dataset’s own records and checks what is claimed about it: its quality claims against its own sample and profile, its current schema against the documented or prior one, its license against the intended use, its synthetic-data disclosure against its provenance, its freshness against its update log, its lineage against its source records, its privacy claims against its contents and handling, and its coverage against the population it is said to represent. Beside it, wever_data-evidence-check inspects one JSON sample field by field and wever_evaluation-dataset-check reads an evaluation set against what an agent must handle, while a dataset check reads a claim made about a dataset against the dataset’s own records; wever_license-evidence-check names the license family a text matches, while the license check reads the terms against one intended use; and wever_privacy-evidence-check reads privacy claims against a policy document, while the privacy check reads the dataset’s contents and handling records. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-datasets-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-datasets/.
